```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
outcomes <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "outcomes")
roster_pos <- DBI::dbGetQuery(
  con,
  "SELECT playerId, season, any_value(position) AS position FROM roster GROUP BY playerId, season"
)
endings <- career_endings(outcomes, roster_pos) |> label_endings()
state_fill <- ending_palette()
state_lab <- c(ending_labels(), playing = "Still playing")
horizon <- 3L
min_curve <- 30
ordinal <- function(n) c("first", "second", "third", "fourth", "fifth")[n]
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
ci <- ending_incidence(endings) |> filter(group != "Position not recorded")
thin <- thin_position_groups(ci, horizon, min_curve)
at_horizon <- ci |>
  filter(time == horizon, !group %in% thin) |>
  mutate(label = factor(state_lab[state], names(state_fill)))
nfl_share <- at_horizon |>
  filter(state %in% c("drafted", "signed_udfa")) |>
  summarise(nfl = sum(estimate), .by = "group") |>
  arrange(desc(nfl))

p <- at_horizon |>
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, rev(as.character(nfl_share$group))),
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s players at risk going into season %d)",
      group, time, pct(estimate), tolower(label), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(n_risk), time
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(100 * estimate, group, fill = label)) +
  geom_col_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, state), group = label),
    width = 0.75,
    colour = "#9CA3AF",
    linewidth = 0.3,
    position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = mutate(nfl_share, group = factor(group, rev(as.character(nfl_share$group)))),
    aes(x = 100 * nfl + 1, y = group, label = paste0(pct(nfl, 0), " NFL")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "#111827"
  ) +
  # The two NFL routes keep their colours; the other endings go pale.
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      state_fill[c("Drafted", "Signed undrafted")],
      "Eligibility ended, undrafted" = "#D1D5DB",
      "Left the data" = "#E5E7EB",
      "Still playing" = "#F3F4F6"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%"), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))) +
  labs(
    title = sprintf("How careers had ended by the %s eligible season", ordinal(horizon)),
    subtitle = "Percent of each position's eligible players by how their career had ended; label: drafted plus signed",
    x = "Percent of the group's eligible players",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.75)),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.9, "lines")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))

card_thumbnail(p, "career-endings-by-position", release = release, height = 6.5)
card_interactive(p, height_svg = 7)
```

```{r}
#| label: route-curves
route_ci <- route_incidence(endings) |>
  filter(group != "Position not recorded", n_risk >= min_curve, !group %in% thin) |>
  mutate(group = factor(group, position_group_levels()))
route_colour <- c(
  Drafted = state_fill[["Drafted"]],
  `Signed undrafted` = state_fill[["Signed undrafted"]],
  `Either NFL route` = "#374151"
)
p_routes <- route_ci |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = sprintf(
      "%s, by season %d: %s %s (95%% CI %s to %s; %s at risk)",
      group, time, pct(estimate), tolower(route), pct(lower), pct(upper), fmt(n_risk)
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(time, 100 * estimate, colour = route, fill = route)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 100 * lower, ymax = 100 * upper), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point_interactive(aes(tooltip = tooltip, data_id = paste(group, state)), size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~group, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = route_colour) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = route_colour) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:5) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Each position's cumulative percent reaching the NFL, season by season",
    subtitle = "Cumulative percent of eligible players by eligible season, with confidence intervals",
    x = "Eligible season",
    y = "Cumulative percent",
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = paste0(
      "Seasons with fewer than ", min_curve, " players at risk are omitted.",
      if (length(thin)) paste0(" Omitted groups: ", paste(tolower(thin), collapse = ", "), ".") else "",
      " Hover a point for its interval."
    )
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_routes, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 10)
```
